assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: reusable Mochi expression/acting sheet for an original cat IP, not a finished comic.
Reference image 1 is the accepted blue-studio keyframe: strictly preserve Mochi's original fluffy orange-gold kitten, cream muzzle/chest, pink nose and round warm dark eyes; Lucky's warm charcoal BLACK shorter-furred kitten, large pointed ears, small dark nose and yellow-green round eyes. Reference image 2 is the original painting and defines LARGE flat broken matte gouache brush masses and simplified natural kitten proportions. These are our original cats, not upright human mascots. No fine individual-hair rendering, polished shading, airbrush, vector outlines, clothing, human hands, human grins, permanent accessories, or copied franchise characters. Keep connected cat anatomy, consistent small cat mouths and recognizable face/ear/head-body proportions.
Only Mochi appears; fluffy orange-gold coat, cream mouth/chest, tiny pink nose; original orange sister only, no black cat.
Exactly SIX complete drawings, THREE columns by TWO rows in one LANDSCAPE sheet. Each cell contains ONE WHOLE kitten, entire ears, whiskers, shoulders, forelegs, hindquarters, paws and tail comfortably inside its own cell with a generous transparent gutter. GENUINE alpha transparency, no floor, no cast shadow field, no background rectangle. Stable seated natural kitten pose, fixed three-quarter angle, equal scale and common foot baseline across all six cells; acting changes are SMALL and legible in eyes, ears, tiny mouth and head angle, not a new face/body design. Natural cat posture, never crossed arms or human standing body. Do NOT cut the neck or paws, do not isolate floating body parts.
Read left to right then second row: 1 warm attentive listening, relaxed original round eyes and soft ears; 2 a quietly suppressed laugh, eyes softly curved, tiny CLOSED cat mouth, no human grin; 3 pleasantly surprised, original-sized eyes a little wider and ears perked, no giant open mouth; 4 mildly caught secretly enjoying something, gaze away and small sideways ear angle, not fear or shame; 5 genuine caring concern, eyes focus slightly down and head leans forward a little, no tears; 6 privately proud of Lucky, gentle direct gaze with one tiny slow-blink beginning, affectionate not patronizing.
No text, labels, numbers, logo, bubble, frame, watermark or UI. No grumpy-face default: Mochi has warmth, curiosity and private enthusiasm while remaining recognizably calm. Every cat fully opaque; all pixels outside the kitten silhouettes genuinely transparent, not a painted gradient, orange glow, smoky haze or feathered halo. Broad matte gouache planes, no fine hair.
